name: Riverside Roasted Green Circle Chicken & Potato Fondant
whyItWorks: Roasted free-range chicken breast, butter-braised peeled Yukon Gold potato fondant, and cooked apple pectin chutney are naturally low-residue and citrus-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the roasted chicken, peeled Yukon potato fondant, and cooked Honeycrisp apple chutney while pushing the Brussels sprouts to the side.
watchOuts: Whole Brussels sprouts on the plate
